title: Agent profile
description: One agent role profile, as `.ai/agents/<slug>.md`. An agent profile is the only document that declares what a *tool* may do, so `tools` and `mode` are constrained here in a way no other document constrains permissions: a profile that names a tool must say what it wants to do with it.

mode.description: `plan` is the default and the safe one. `execute` is only in force with a task's `touches` allowlist behind it.

tool.description: Capability name, identical to the tool name so a permission entry resolves it.

system_prompt.description: Optional extra instructions. The project rulebook is never defined here: `.ai/` is policy supplied by the developer, and a profile that could restate it would create a second, editable copy.
